    AI Overview
    Brazil defeated Croatia 3-1
     in a 2026 international friendly match played on March 31, 2026, at Camping World Stadium in Orlando, Florida. The match served as a key "Road to '26" tune-up, featuring goals from Danilo and others, allowing Brazil to rebound from a recent loss to France while testing their lineup before the upcoming World Cup. 
    Match Details and Highlights 
    • Final Score: Brazil 3-1 Croatia.
    • Date: March 31, 2026.
    • Location: Camping World Stadium, Orlando, Florida.
    • Key Moments: Danilo scored for Brazil, and the team displayed a strong performance to overcome a recent defeat by France.
    • Context: This was a high-profile friendly match serving as preparation for the 2026 FIFA World Cup, played as part of the "Road to '26" series. 
    Key Takeaways 
    • Brazil's Form: Under Carlos Ancelotti, Brazil aimed to solidify their championship pedigree ahead of the 2026 World Cup, addressing tactical gaps after a 2-1 loss to France.
    • Croatia's Status: Croatia arrived in Florida following a recent 2-1 win over Colombia in Orlando, showing strong form prior to this matchup.
    • Historic Rivalry: This matchup was highly anticipated as a rematch of the 2022 World Cup quarterfinal, where Croatia eliminated Brazil on penalties.
    • Next Steps: Brazil is set to face Morocco in their 2026 World Cup Group C opener, while Croatia prepares to face England. 
    This information is based on reports dated March 31 - April 1, 2026.
